exampleEn: The team's new strategy really helped turn the tide in their favor.
exampleKo: 팀의 새로운 전략이 정말로 그들에게 유리하게 상황을 변화시켰다.
gameExamples: The community came together to turn the tide against the pollution affecting the river.
By implementing new policies, the government hopes to turn the tide on unemployment rates this year.
Her inspiring speech was able to turn the tide of public opinion on the crucial issue.
